examples.en: This software is much friendlier than the previous version.
examples.zh: 这个软件比之前的版本好用得多。

examples.en: Within a few days, his "Good morning!" was returned by a lot of "Good mornings" and the whole bus seemed to be friendlier.
examples.zh: 几天之内，他的“早上好”得到了很多人的“早上好”的回应，整辆公共汽车似乎变得更和睦了。

examples.en: People in vacation spots, like the Jersey Shore, were far friendlier than those hustling to work downtown.
examples.zh: 在像泽西海岸这样的度假胜地，人们比那些在市区忙着上班的人要友好得多。
